schema_learning: Carrier legibility alone is insufficient. Cultural carriers placed on perimeter chamfers or bounded rear fields need an explicit body-continuity constraint: finish changes must remain flush and borderless unless a real assembly part is intended; local chamfer variation must not create isolated corner caps. Camera-internal radial hierarchy remains safest but needs one secondary visible relationship to avoid cultural absence.
